raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "libint" %}
{% set version = "2.14.1" %}
{% set version_src = "2.14.1" %}
{% set build = 0 %}

# toy-sized source tarball for recipe testing (L2 tests halting)
{% set url_toy = "https://github.com/loriab/libint/releases/download/v0.1/libint-2.14.1-2-2-3-2_0.tgz" %}
{% set sha256_toy = "67bca412250f25470307e2f7bf7500053d2832700acd7a6e7860948b1894370a" %}

# production source tarball: L/M build w/i 3h but W can't get through it w/i 6h
{% set url_bells = "https://github.com/loriab/libint/releases/download/v0.1/libint-2.14.1-7-6-4-7-7-6_mm10f12ob2_0.tgz" %}
{% set sha256_bells = "e2ebd1359a9ac3b4a04f4249e356c7688d1e2e5b46a3ad07ac8601b1c030aaa4" %}

# production source tarball: no Hessian ERIs but works for W. ppc64le now too
{% set url_basic = "https://github.com/loriab/libint/releases/download/v0.1/libint-2.14.1-7-6-7-7_mm10f12ob2_0.tgz" %}
{% set sha256_basic = "a2e00da4daedb616f8d97f44504ae2b44658705c261e7635cdc10dbbe5fac939" %}

# production source tarball: [Nov 2026] Now UNUSED w/Hessian but lighter E/G that works on the other L arch (could try big one again once non-emulated)
{% set url_littlebells = "https://github.com/loriab/libint/releases/download/v0.1/libint-2.13.1-5-5-3-6-6-4_mm10f12ob2_0.tgz" %}
{% set sha256_littlebells = "8d2ee07a8178cfbca354750ef9445cfe37ecaab0d4ab95222b457587588ce9e7" %}

# production source tarball:
{% set url_lite = "https://github.com/loriab/libint/releases/download/v0.1/libint-2.14.1-4-4-5-5_mm10f12ob2_0.tgz" %}
{% set sha256_lite = "44c8ab8c062e6e8e19ed005f68c2369a8d0c30a6c307635a25651a8833767766" %}

# source tarball pattern for upstream
# {% set url = "https://github.com/evaleev/{{ name }}/releases/download/v{{ version }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tgz" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}-split
  version: {{ version }}

# NOTE TO ANYONE ITERATING BUILD CHANGES: This recipe takes many hours.
#   But if you toggle the url and sha for all arch to url_toy and sha256_toy, it'll
#   take <30m and all recipe tests will still pass. This is highly recommended for sanity.

source:
  # url: {{ url_toy }}
  url: {{ url_bells }}        # [(am_type == "full") and unix and not ppc64le]
  url: {{ url_basic }}        # [(am_type == "full") and (win or ppc64le)]
  url: {{ url_lite }}         # [am_type == "lite"]
  # sha256: {{ sha256_toy }}
  sha256: {{ sha256_bells }}  # [(am_type == "full") and unix and not ppc64le]
  sha256: {{ sha256_basic }}  # [(am_type == "full") and (win or ppc64le)]
  sha256: {{ sha256_lite }}   # [am_type == "lite"]
  # note: source/url above is a tarball of generated library source code.
  # * the upstream generator project is: https://github.com/evaleev/libint
  # * tarballs aren't upstream release artifacts but have been generated with
  #   different configuration from upstream release tag. See NOTES file.
  # * W times out and linux-aarch64 abandons at ~5h, so these use smaller src

{% if am_type == "full" %}
{% set build = build + 100 %}
{% endif %}
build:
  force_use_keys:
    - am_type
  number: {{ build }}
  script_env:
    - ENABLE_FORTRAN=ON                   # [unix]
    - ENABLE_FORTRAN=OFF                  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - {{ compiler("c") }}
    - {{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - {{ compiler("fortran") }}           # [unix]
    - cmake
    - ninja
  host:
    # note: alternately, could withhold boost here so that a vendored subset of boost headers gets installed
    #   at include/libint2/boost/ . Then downstream builds against libint2 don't need a Boost dependency.
    # * OpenMP only present in one L2 file
    - libboost-headers
    - eigen
    - llvm-openmp                         # [unix]

outputs:
  - name: libint
    build:
      string: {{ am_type }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - {{ compiler("c") }}
        - {{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - libboost-headers
        - eigen
        - llvm-openmp                     # [unix]
    files:
      - lib/libint2{{ SHLIB_EXT }}*       # [linux]
      - lib/libint2{{ SHLIB_EXT }}        # [osx]
      - lib/libint2.3{{ SHLIB_EXT }}      # [osx]
      - share/libint                      # [unix]
      - Library/bin/int2*                 # [win]
      - Library/lib/int2*                 # [win]
      - Library/share/libint              # [win]
    test:
      commands:
        # - ls -l $PREFIX/lib                                                # [unix]
        # - dir %PREFIX%\\Library                                            # [win]
        # Verify library
        # * Note that W dll preferred but not useable at last attempt https://github.com/evaleev/libint/issues/237
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                              # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2.a                                    # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                          # [unix]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\int2.lib exit 1               # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\bin\\int2.dll exit 1                   # [win]
        # Verify (almost no) accessories
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint2.h                                # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint2/engine.h                         # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint2/boost/preprocessor.hpp           # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/share/libint/{{ version_src }}/basis/sto-6g.g94    # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-config.cmake           # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint_f.mod                             # [unix]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2.h exit 1              # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2\\engine.h exit 1      # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2\\boost\\preprocessor.hpp exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\share\\libint\\{{ version_src }}\\basis\\sto-6g.g94 exit 1  # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\cmake\\libint2\\libint2-config.cmake exit 1  # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint_f.mod exit 1           # [win]
        # Inspect linkage
        - ldd -v $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                               # [linux and build_platform == target_platform]
        - otool -L $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                             # [osx]

  - name: libint-devel
    build:
      string: {{ am_type }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
      run_exports:
        # libraries aren't hot-swappable (even by a *more* capable lib) and there's differences in config.h btwn full/lite
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint', exact=True) }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint', exact=True) }}
    files:
      - include/libint2.h*                    # [unix]
      - include/libint2/*.h*                  # [unix]
      - include/libint2/util/*.h*             # [unix]
      - include/libint2/util/generated/*.h*   # [unix]
      - include/libint2/lcao/*.h*             # [unix]
      - include/libint2/chemistry/*.h*        # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/libint2/Find*               # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-config*     # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-targets-C*  # [unix]
      - Library/include/libint2.h*            # [win]
      - Library/include/libint2               # [win]
      - Library/lib/cmake/libint2             # [win]
    test:
      commands:
        # - ls -l $PREFIX/lib                                                # [unix]
        # - ls -l $PREFIX/lib/cmake/libint2                                  # [unix]
        # - dir %PREFIX%\\Library                                            # [win]
        # - dir %PREFIX%\\Library\\include                                   # [win]
        # Verify library
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                              # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                          # [unix]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\int2.lib exit 1               # [win]
        # Verify accessories
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/libint2.h                                  # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/libint2/engine.h                           # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint2/boost/preprocessor.hpp           # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/share/libint/{{ version_src }}/basis/sto-6g.g94    # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-config.cmake             # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint_f.mod                             # [unix]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2.h exit 1          # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2\\engine.h exit 1  # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2\\boost\\preprocessor.hpp exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\share\\libint\\{{ version_src }}\\basis\\sto-6g.g94 exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\cmake\\libint2\\libint2-config.cmake exit 1  # [win]
        - if exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint_f.mod exit 1           # [win]

  - name: libint-cxx-devel
    build:
      string: {{ am_type }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint', exact=True) }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint-devel', exact=True) }}
        - eigen
        - libboost-headers
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - python 3.12  # only for running a validation script, so suppress all but one Py version. update as necessary.
      files:
        - tests/hartree-fock/CMakeLists.txt
      source_files:
        - features
        - tests/hartree-fock/h2o_rotated.xyz
        - tests/hartree-fock/hartree-fock++.cc
        - tests/hartree-fock/hartree-fock++-validate.py
      commands:
        # Verify library
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                              # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                          # [unix]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\int2.lib exit 1               # [win]
        # Verify accessories
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/libint2.hpp                                # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-config.cmake             # [unix]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\libint2.hpp exit 1        # [win]
        - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\cmake\\libint2\\libint2-config.cmake exit 1  # [win]
        # Actually test
        - cd tests/hartree-fock
        - set "LDFLAGS=%LDFLAGS:/link =%"                                    # [win]
        - cmake -S. -Bbuild -GNinja -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${PREFIX}"          # [unix]
        - cmake -S. -Bbuild -GNinja -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%" -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release  # [win]
        - cmake --build build
        - set -o pipefail                                                    # [unix]
        - ./build/hf++ h2o_rotated.xyz | python hartree-fock++-validate.py ../../features  # [unix]
        - build\\hf++.exe h2o_rotated.xyz | python hartree-fock++-validate.py ..\\..\\features  # [win]

  - name: libint-fortran
    build:
      skip: true                                                             # [win]
      string: {{ am_type }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - {{ compiler("c") }}
        - {{ compiler("fortran") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint', exact=True) }}
    files:
      - lib/libint2_f{{ SHLIB_EXT }}*                                        # [linux]
      - lib/libint2_f*{{ SHLIB_EXT }}                                        # [osx]
    test:
      commands:
        # Verify library
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                              # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                            # [unix]
        # Verify (no) accessories
        - test ! -e $PREFIX/include/libint_f.mod                             # [unix]
        - test ! -f $PREFIX/include/libint2.h                                # [unix]
        # Inspect linkage
        - ldd -v $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                             # [linux and build_platform == target_platform]
        - otool -L $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                           # [osx]

  - name: libint-fortran-devel
    build:
      skip: true                                                             # [win]
      string: {{ am_type }}_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint-fortran', exact=True) }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint-fortran', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libint-devel', exact=True) }}
    files:
      - include/*.mod                                                        # [unix]
      - include/libint2/fortran/*                                            # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/libint2/libint2-targets-Fortran*                           # [unix]
    test:
      commands:
        # Verify library
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2$SHLIB_EXT                              # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libint2_f$SHLIB_EXT                            # [unix]
        # Verify accessories
        - test -e $PREFIX/include/libint_f.mod                               # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/libint2.h                                  # [unix]

about:
  home: https://github.com/evaleev/libint
  dev_url: https://github.com/evaleev/libint
  doc_url: https://github.com/evaleev/libint/wiki
  license: LGPL-3.0-only
  license_url: https://opensource.org/license/lgpl-3-0/
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - COPYING.LESSER
  license_family: LGPL
  summary: "Libint is E. Valeev's library for the evaluation of molecular integrals of many-body operators over Gaussian functions"

extra:
